rows.label: Exolizers per reward (normal Void Cascade)
rows.variant: normal (not Alert; not The Circuit fixed length)
rows.shared_with: Alert missions replace the interval with ALERT_REWARD_INTERVAL (proto 73)

limits.basis: R22: the interval is a divisor (proto 28 floor(used / interval)) and a first-reward threshold (proto 12); 1 = a reward per exolizer. LOADN domain 1..32767.

rows.evidence: ZarimanSurvivalMission 44.0.2 (body 32c344afa33be174), readable decompile work/research/universal-mission-editor-2026-09-29/decomp: the root sets REWARD_INTERVAL = 4 (proto 97 i80 LOADN, i81 SETTABLEKS, L97) and copies it once into the root local frame_97[177] (i237 GETTABLEKS, L214); the module has no other use of the key (census: i81 write, i237 read). Alert missions overwrite frame_97[177] with ALERT_REWARD_INTERVAL in proto 73 (L8141-8147). Readers of frame_97[177]: proto 28 (L4073-4108) gives reward tier n for every n up to floor(pillarsUsed / interval) (OnTieredRewardRoundOver(n - 1)); pillarsUsed (frame_97[170]) counts exolizers whose timer ran out (proto 45 L6188-6198); proto 12 (L2393-2416) fails the mission when the cascade meter reaches 0 before the first reward; proto 2 (L649) is a debug line. Because the only reader of the table field is the root copy, the addon root-table lane cannot own it (gate test_phase2e_gates case 'root reads the field at module load'); the literal lane rewrites the initialiser before the root runs.
